finalists.label: Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
finalists.why: This candidate has the most comprehensive evidence, including cardiac rhabdomyoma, depigmented spots on torso, and a TSC1 gene mutation.

finalists.label: Genetic Disorder
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by multiple findings, including polydactyly of the right hand, cardiac rhabdomyoma, and a TSC1 gene mutation.

frontier_selector.why: The TSC1 gene mutation and the presence of multiple characteristic features, such as cardiac rhabdomyoma and depigmented spots, make Tuberous Sclerosis Complex the most specific and comprehensive diagnosis.
